# `silk/json/schema_format_idna`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

International hostname validation for JSON Schema using Unicode 16.0.0 UTS #46 mapping.

Mapping is nontransitional. IDNA2008 contextual rules, canonical Punycode, DNS wire lengths,
NFC, and the domain-wide RFC 5893 bidirectional rule are checked without DNS access.

Public declarations: 1.

<a id="check"></a>

## `check`

```silk
pub effect fn check(value: string) -> bool ! OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns whether a name passes nontransitional UTS #46 and IDNA2008 hostname checks.
Empty labels and trailing dots are rejected. Allocation failures propagate to the caller.
